description: Website and backend synchronization services for Fever Dream Comedy. Stack: React (Vite), Firebase Hosting, Cloud Functions, and Firestore.

tasks.title: Define conversion events and tracking governance
requirements: Identify the primary lead-conversion actions for the site, including booking inquiries, contact submissions, newsletter/subscribe actions, and outbound ticket clicks.
Define a consistent event schema for page views, engagement events, and lead conversions so the same signals can feed Google Tag Manager and Meta Pixel.
Document consent and privacy expectations before firing marketing tags in production.
Establish one source of truth for browser events to avoid double-counting across tags.

tasks.title: Install Google Tag Manager across the Vite app
requirements: Add Google Tag Manager support to the React/Vite app and ensure the container loads on all public pages.
Make the GTM container id configurable through environment variables.
Preserve static prerendering and avoid blocking initial render.
Add verification coverage or a smoke-test path for the injected snippet.

tasks.title: Wire Meta Pixel conversion tracking through GTM
requirements: Load Meta Pixel via Google Tag Manager and configure the base PageView event.
Track key lead and engagement events such as ViewContent, Contact, Lead, and outbound booking clicks.
Align event names and payloads with Meta's recommended conversion events for ad optimization.
Add debug and verification instructions for validating pixel fires in staging and production.

tasks.title: Validate marketing tracking and document the setup
requirements: Confirm GTM and Meta Pixel fire correctly across the core pages and conversion flows.
Check for duplicate events, broken tags, and performance regressions.
Document required environment variables, GTM container setup, and Meta Pixel QA steps.

tasks.title: Notify admins when new site messages are created
requirements: Set up a Cloud Function or equivalent backend trigger to send notifications whenever a new site message is created.
Request browser notification permissions only after the user has passed the /admin authentication gate, never on public pages.
Ensure admin users can receive and test notifications without exposing the permission prompt to unauthenticated visitors.
Document the notification delivery path, permission UX, and any required Firebase or browser configuration.

tasks.title: Embed Eventbrite checkout iframe for ticket sales
requirements: Replace or augment the outbound ticket CTA with Eventbrite's supported embedded checkout or registration iframe so users can complete purchase without leaving the site.
Preserve funnel continuity by keeping the branding, event context, and conversion tracking active around the embedded flow.
Ensure the embed degrades gracefully on mobile and in browsers that block third-party iframes or scripts.
Document any Eventbrite organizer settings, embed codes, or account prerequisites needed to enable the embedded checkout experience.
Update conversion events to include eventbrite ticket sale completion
tasks.notes: Implemented Eventbrite embedded checkout using the OFFICIAL widget (eb_widgets.js -> EBWidgets.createWidget), not a hand-rolled iframe. src/lib/eventbrite.js: id extraction (explicit eventbriteId or ticketUrl), getContainerId, buildWidgetOptions, getEmbedConfig gating, isSecureContextForEmbed, kill-switch VITE_EVENTBRITE_EMBED_ENABLED. src/components/EventbriteCheckout.jsx: lazy-loads the widget script on click, mounts into a deterministic container, 10s watchdog -> fallback panel, outbound link when no id / kill-switch / non-https / no iframe support, always-available Open-in-new-tab + Buy-on-Eventbrite links. Conversion: ticket_click (InitiateCheckout) on open; ticket_purchase (Purchase) via the widget onOrderComplete callback plus ?checkout=complete return-URL marker, one-shot guarded. Added ticket_purchase to tracking.js + metaPixel.js (-> Purchase). Styles in index.css for .eventbrite-embed-container. scripts/verify-eventbrite.mjs (24 checks) + npm run verify:eventbrite; verify:tracking now includes it. Docs updated in docs/tracking.md §9 and README.md. NOTE: legacy /tickets-external endpoint is retired (HTTP 404) - do not reintroduce it. Widget requires https, so plain http://localhost shows the outbound fallback. lint clean, build 16 pages, verify:tracking all pass.
